entries.german: Balthasar von Hanau beauftragt Georg von Rosenberg, für ihn die Bambergischen Stiftslehen zu empfangen.
entries.english: Balthasar von Hanau commissions Georg von Rosenberg to receive the Bamberg collegiate fiefs on his behalf.

facts.content: was commissioned by Balthasar von Hanau to receive the Bamberg collegiate fiefs on his behalf.
